items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: Well I had a little kid of my own play guitar. What was his name? Oh his name was Walton Nelson.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I... He playing guitar? No, he was playing sax. Playing saxophone? Yeah.

But at them times he was learning. But I thought they'd done well enough to record with, you know, between myself.
